questions.title: isinstance issubclass Trio Output
questions.description: What does this snippet print?
questions.codesnippet:
class Animal:
    pass

class Dog(Animal):
    pass

d = Dog()
print(isinstance(d, Animal))
print(issubclass(Dog, Animal))
print(issubclass(Animal, Dog))

questions.Option2: 'ChildParent' because both versions run in order
questions.Option3: 'Parent' because the parent method has priority
questions.Option4: 'Child' and then 'Parent' on two separate lines

questions.title: Instance Attribute Shadows Class
questions.description: w gets an instance attribute kind that shadows the class attribute. What does this snippet print?
questions.codesnippet:
class Widget:
    kind = "generic"

    def show(self):
        return self.kind

w = Widget()
w.kind = "custom"
print(w.show())
print(Widget.kind)
